eq-ch06-sources-lambda: Wavelength in micrometres from wavenumber in inverse centimetres.
eq-ch06-sources-out: Layout of the tensor a source returns: extinction, albedo and phase moments, or extinction alone.
eq-ch06-sources-nprop: Width of the band's prop buffer: the widest of its sources.
eq-ch06-rayleigh-sigma: Dalgarno-Williams fit of the H2 Rayleigh cross section per molecule.
eq-ch06-rayleigh-k: Rayleigh extinction: the H2 cross section per mole times the scaled sum of the concentrations.
eq-ch06-rayleigh-phase: Legendre moments of the Rayleigh phase function: chi_0 = 1, chi_2 = 1/10, all others 0.
eq-ch06-mie-q: Extinction and scattering efficiencies as sums over the Mie coefficients (Wiscombe 1980, eqs. 1a-1b).
eq-ch06-mie-g: Asymmetry parameter as a sum over the Mie coefficients (Wiscombe 1980, eq. 1c).
eq-ch06-mie-ab: Mie coefficients from the logarithmic derivative D_j and Riccati-Bessel functions.
eq-ch06-mie-nstop: Wiscombe's truncation of the Mie series.
eq-ch06-mie-small: Small-particle limit of the efficiencies from the dipole coefficient a_1.
eq-ch06-mie-k: Extinction of a layer of droplets from the efficiency, the water content and the droplet radius.
eq-ch06-mie-hg: Henyey-Greenstein moments g^l from the Mie asymmetry parameter.
eq-ch06-mie-nk: Refractive index of water interpolated in ln(wavelength) from the Segelstein table.
eq-ch06-picaso-tnom: Nominal temperature at the layer pressure and the layer's temperature offset.
eq-ch06-picaso-interp: Multilinear interpolation of ln kappa in wavenumber, ln p and temperature offset.
eq-ch06-picaso-k: Extinction from the pre-mixed cross section and the total molar concentration.
